start.responsibility: Serves as the entry/anchor node that captures and frames the user's initial request — designing an e-commerce order-processing module that combines a state machine, a Saga choreography/orchestration, and a layered fallback strategy, with the order-detail subgraph expanded in depth and the remaining processing steps kept at a high level of abstraction.
start.implementation: As a start node in a task graph, it carries no executable logic of its own; instead it supplies the scope, vocabulary, and boundary conditions that downstream nodes (e.g. the deliverable) will use to produce the artifact, typically a Mermaid state-machine diagram whose detail density is non-uniform — dense around order-detail, sparse elsewhere.
start.design_intent: Exists to lock in the starting point and the selective-depth contract of the task: it tells the rest of the pipeline that the artifact must demonstrate all three patterns (state machine, Saga, layered fallback) but that only one sub-flow deserves full elaboration, so that effort and detail concentrate where they matter most.
start.constraints: Scope is bounded to an e-commerce order-processing module; the three mandated patterns (state machine + Saga + layered fallback) must all be represented; depth is asymmetric — order-detail is the only fully expanded subgraph, all other steps must remain high-level abstractions; output form is expected to be Mermaid state-machine source code; no specific implementation framework or runtime details are implied by this node alone.

draft-saga.responsibility: Produce a high-level Saga sequence diagram for the order processing pipeline (Order → Inventory → Payment → Logistics) including forward orchestration and per-step compensation flows.
draft-saga.implementation: Authored as a Task artifact expressed in Mermaid (sequenceDiagram or stateDiagram-v2) syntax, sketching participants and forward messages for each step plus a paired compensating action per step, kept at an abstract level except where the task explicitly expands a sub-graph.
draft-saga.design_intent: Establishes the cross-service transaction contract and rollback topology that complements the order-detail state machine, giving the reader a single view of happy-path progression versus failure recovery before drilling into any single step's internals.
draft-saga.constraints: Must remain at high-level abstraction for every step except order-detail; must depict both forward and compensation edges for each participant; must align with the upstream plan-structure and feed the downstream deliverable without overlapping state-machine detail that belongs in the order-detail sub-graph.

deliverable.responsibility: Produce the detailed Mermaid state-machine specification for the order-detail step of an e-commerce order pipeline, capturing its internal Receive→Auth→LoadAggregate→StateFilter→Compose→Render flow plus the named branch cases.
deliverable.implementation: Author a stateDiagram-v2 source describing the six sequential states for order-detail and representing the four edge-case branches (permission denied, order not found, deleted, snapshot degradation) as guarded transitions or alternative terminal states, while leaving the surrounding Saga steps at a higher level of abstraction.
deliverable.design_intent: To make the order-detail sub-flow explicit and reviewable in isolation, complementing the broader Saga/state-machine design so that the layered-fallback strategy for this single step is documented concretely while peer steps remain abstract.
deliverable.constraints: Output must be Mermaid state-machine syntax; only the order-detail step is expanded in detail; the four named branch conditions must be represented as part of the sub-graph; confidence is bounded at 0.6 because the description is inferred from L0 metadata only.

plan-structure.responsibility: Plan the top-level layout of the Mermaid documentation by deciding that the file will be composed of four complementary diagram blocks (main state machine, Saga sequence, layered safety-net, and an expanded order-detail subgraph).
plan-structure.implementation: A decomposition task that partitions the downstream deliverable into four drafting subtasks, mapping each conceptual view (control flow, choreography, fallback, detail) to its own draft node without specifying concrete diagram mechanics at this stage.
plan-structure.design_intent: To separate concerns before drafting so that the complex order-processing logic is presented through distinct, complementary lenses rather than as one monolithic diagram, and to ensure only the order-detail slice is elaborated in detail while the others remain high-level abstractions.
plan-structure.constraints: Fixed four-part structure (main FSM, Saga, layered safety-net, order-detail subgraph); order-detail is the sole subgraph expanded with full detail; the other three blocks must remain at high-level abstraction; output medium is Mermaid source.

draft-safety-net.responsibility: Draft a layered fallback/safety-net architecture specification that assigns concrete degradation strategies (timeout, circuit breaking, fallback, snapshot, rate limiting, circuit-breaking+alerting) to each of five tiers (UI, API, Domain, Infrastructure, Monitoring) for the order processing module.
draft-safety-net.implementation: Authored as a structured document or diagram (likely Mermaid-compatible) that, per layer, states the layer's role, the failure modes it must absorb, the chosen resilience pattern, and the trigger/response behavior; it is produced as a sub-deliverable of the overall plan-structure and feeds into the consolidated deliverable that also contains the order-detail state machine and Saga decomposition.
draft-safety-net.design_intent: The node exists to give the order processing design explicit defense-in-depth: the state machine and Saga handle happy-path and compensating flows, while this layered safety net ensures that each tier fails gracefully and observably when the underlying assumptions of those flows break, so that partial outages do not cascade across the system.
draft-safety-net.constraints: Coverage must span all five named tiers (UI, API, Domain, Infrastructure, Monitoring); each layer must specify which of the named strategies (timeout, circuit break, fallback, snapshot, rate limiting, circuit break + alerting) it owns; strategies across layers must be non-conflicting and consistent with the state machine + Saga orchestration; Monitoring-tier alerting must be defined broadly enough to surface degradations triggered at any lower layer; output is a prerequisite consumed by the downstream deliverable node.

draft-order-detail-fsm.responsibility: 为订单处理模块中的 order-detail 步骤产出一份详细的子状态机草图，作为整体订单处理 FSM 拆解后可单独评审与实现的设计单元。
draft-order-detail-fsm.implementation: 按 L0 元数据，应以 Mermaid 状态机源码形式表达主路径 Receive→AuthCheck→LoadAggregate→StateFilter→ComposeResponse→Render，并在同一图上显式标注 Denied / NotFound / SoftDeleted / SnapshotFallback 四条分支出口；粒度上仅展开 order-detail 这一步，其余步骤保持高层抽象。
draft-order-detail-fsm.design_intent: 在 plan-structure 给出整体编排之后，将订单详情查询这一最复杂、易出边界条件（鉴权失败、聚合缺失、软删、降级快照）的子流程单独成图，使责任清晰、可独立走查，并作为最终 deliverable 中可被引用与测试的最小可讨论单元。
draft-order-detail-fsm.constraints: 仅展开 order-detail 子图，其他 Saga/兜底层保持抽象；必须覆盖 L0 列出的四条分支出口；遵循 Mermaid 状态机语法以保证可渲染；不得在此节点引入未在 L0 中出现的状态或机制细节（受 L0-only 推理限制）。

draft-main-fsm.responsibility: Author the canonical order-lifecycle finite state machine (PENDING→PAID→FULFILLING→SHIPPED→COMPLETED→CLOSED|CANCELLED) with a high-level compensation entry point, serving as the shared backbone for the downstream order-detail sub-diagram and the final deliverable.
draft-main-fsm.implementation: At the role level: produces a Mermaid state-diagram source artifact that names each forward state, marks terminal states, and exposes a compensation transition usable by the Saga layer; defers all internal detail of the order-detail step to a sibling task and keeps every other step at high-level abstraction.
draft-main-fsm.design_intent: Establishes a single agreed-upon state vocabulary up front so that the Saga orchestration, the layered fallback strategy, and the order-detail subgraph can each reference one canonical FSM instead of inventing their own state sets, and so the plan-structure step's chosen flow ordering is reflected as enforceable transitions.
draft-main-fsm.constraints: Must enumerate the named states (PENDING, PAID, FULFILLING, SHIPPED, COMPLETED, CLOSED, CANCELLED) with their forward ordering; must retain an explicit compensation/exception entry point rather than collapsing it into a terminal state; scope is restricted to the main flow FSM, leaving the order-detail internals and other pipeline steps to companion nodes; output is a Mermaid source consistent with the deliverable's expected format.
